Title: Rohan's Day

Cast

1. Rohan - 12 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Shalini - 41 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Meera - 8 years, friend
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rohan stands in the courtyard. Shalini and Meera stand near him.]

Meera: "What lovely weather!"

[Rohan slips and falls.]

Rohan: "Careful!"

[Rohan trips over a stone.]

Shalini: "Show me too!"

[Rohan hurts his knee.]

Rohan: "And then?"

[Rohan helps Mother get up.]

Rohan: "What happened?"

[Rohan sneezes loudly.]

Meera: "That's great!"

[Rohan coughs.]

Rohan: "I'm ready!"

Scene 2: The bathroom - Day

[Rohan stands in the bathroom. Shalini and Meera stand near him.]

Shalini: "So, here we are!"

[Rohan brushes his teeth at the sink.]

Rohan: "What next?"

[Rohan takes a quick bath.]

Rohan: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
